desc:
The world is in chaos—and only one nation can rise to power. In World War 3, build your army, conquer territories, and clash with other players in a full-scale global war. Buy troops, declare war, and dominate the battlefield in this action-packed strategy game.

💰 Collect Cash
🏝️ Invade Lands
🔧 Upgrade Your Forces
🌍  Expand Your Nation!

👍 Like & Favorite for more updates!
